# victoriametricscloud_custom_alertmanager (Resource)

Manages a custom (externally hosted) Alertmanager notifier in VictoriaMetrics Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication method used to reach the Alertmanager. Valid values: 'basic', 'bearer'.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the notifier.
- `url` (String) URL of the externally hosted Alertmanager. Must use https://.

### Optional

- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for bearer authentication. Required when auth_type is 'bearer'.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for basic authentication. Required when auth_type is 'basic'.
- `username` (String) Username for basic authentication. Required when auth_type is 'basic'.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of notifier creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the notifier.
- `message` (String) Detail message from the last validation of the notifier.
- `notifier` (Attributes) Reference this as the notifier argument of victoriametricscloud_deployment_notifier to attach this notifier to a deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifier))
- `status` (String) Last known health status of the notifier: 'unknown', 'error' or 'active'.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the last notifier update.

<a id="nestedatt--notifier"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifier`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the notifier.
- `type` (String) Type of the notifier.
